verdict.rationale: Medusa is headless, so storefront customization means owning your own frontend code. The evidence supports that: storefront development guides, Next.js and Gatsby starter kits, ownership of the source, GitHub-based deploys with PR previews, and storefront hosting. There is no evidence of a dedicated templating or theme layer, nor of a documented local preview workflow. Missing for 10: a documented templating/theme layer, explicit local preview/dev-server docs, theme-specific versioned deploy tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
